During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Llanic system/Legends|Llanic system]]. In this remote region of space the Empire constructed a secret space station, where were studied biological weapons. The Empire's chemical weapons division had developed a deadly new poison, the [[Ziroxin-12/Legends|Ziroxin-12]], and the chemical was being produced in massive quantities there. However the Republic discovered the Sith's plans and sent the [[Coruscant Aegis]], supported by [[Thranta-class corvette|Thranta starship]], to spearhead assault on the Empire's chemical station. The Republic fought very well destroying the station and all stores of Ziroxin-12.<ref name="LSS" />
